PadRecipe.description: One pad of a recipe. Every number is optional and starts at the voice's default.

choke.description: Pads in the same choke group cut each other, as in the kit format.

decay.description: Time to fall by 60 dB, in seconds.

id.description: The pad id patterns refer to, such as `kick` or `hh-closed`. Also the stem of its sample files.

layers.description: Velocity layers from 1 to 4, split evenly across the range: a soft one at the bottom, the full hit at the top. 2 when missing.

name.description: Display name; the id when missing.

noise.description: How much noise is blended with the pitched part, 0 to 1.

pitch.description: The fundamental, in Hz: where a kick or tom settles, a snare's body, a hat's lowest partial, a clap's band, a cowbell's lower tone.

tone.description: Brightness from 0 (dark) to 1 (bright): the click on a kick, the noise's color on a snare, the cut-off of a hat.

Voice.description: What a pad is synthesized as.

oneOf.description: A sine dropping in pitch with a click on top.
A pitched body under a burst of bright noise.
Six detuned square waves and noise, high-passed: closed with a short decay, open with a long one.
A few bursts of band-limited noise and a short tail.
A sine with a gentle drop in pitch and a little noise.
Two square waves through a band.

description: A kit described as synthesis settings rather than samples.

$schema.description: Ignored; lets an editor find the schema.

name.description: The kit's name, shown in the kit picker.

pads.description: The pads, in the order the sequencer shows them.

seed.description: Seeds the noise. The same recipe and seed give the same samples.
